description: This file defines a singleton class VoiceWakeGlobalSettingsSync responsible for synchronizing voice wake triggers across the app. It manages a background task that maintains a subscription to external gateway updates, decodes payloads, and applies global settings accordingly.

classes.name: VoiceWakeGlobalSettingsSync
classes.description: A singleton class that manages the synchronization of voice wake settings by subscribing to gateway events and updating app state.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins the background task that listens for gateway updates and triggers handling logic.

methods.name: refreshFromGateway
methods.description: Fetches the latest voice wake triggers from the gateway and applies them to app state.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes incoming gateway push events, decodes payloads, and updates app state if relevant.
